args.summary: After v2.3.1 was deployed, checkout-api started failing health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. v2.3.1-rc was also marked unhealthy in the release history. I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy release, in all production regions. After the rollback, all regions run v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate is 0.2%. Next step: find out why v2.3.1 failed before anyone redeploys it.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and the service is healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0002, which paged on-call.

- **Version chosen:** v2.3.0 is the most recent healthy release. The release history shows both releases after it, v2.3.1-rc and v2.3.1, as unhealthy.
- **Rollback:** us-east, us-west and eu-west are all on v2.3.0. A follow-up check shows the service healthy, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** My first attempt to open it timed out. The incident list was still empty afterwards, so I opened it again. There's only one incident (INC-0002) and only one page went out. The incident describes the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback, and recommends finding out why v2.3.1 failed before anyone redeploys it.
